source_excerpt:
U.P. Co-Operative Institutional Service Board (UPCISB) , has released the Result on the official website for the recruitment of Manager, Junior Manager, Assistant/ Cashier (Banking Assistant/Clerical Staff), Assistant/Typist & Assistant Engineer (Civil) in Combined Co-operative Banking and Technical Services Posts. The exam will be conducted on 07 – 08 September 2026 . and the last date to submit the application form was 15 April 2026. Candidates can also check their Result by using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below. ( Advt No: -A1 / S.R. / 2026 )
